verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a user-definable rules engine that fires actions automatically on events. The single line about "trigger post-purchase actions in real-time" names no rule definition, event subscription, or configurable trigger. Mandate decline thresholds and network-level controls are spending guardrails that block transactions, not event-to-action automation, so they count only as adjacent controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
